basic_info.description: Introducing 750 Francisco Street, on the market for the first time in 60 years. Designed in 1941 by renowned architect Oliver Rousseau, this Russian Hill 1 bedroom condo blends architectural pedigree with modern updates and sweeping views of the Bay and city skyline.  The 1-bedroom, 1-bath full floor corner unit spans 1,125 square feet with a large open living and dining area that flows to a 160 sq-ft private deck, a rare outdoor perch in the heart of the city. With east and south exposures, the sunlit living room frames dramatic views of the Bay, Coit Tower, Bay Bridge, and Downtown.  Inside, original Rousseau details, including built-ins and refinished hardwood floors, pair with a brand-new kitchen designed for today's living. The vintage bath, with both a tub and walk-in shower, combines function and character.  Function meets rarity with 2 parking spaces, 110 sq-ft of storage, a shared garden and a spacious laundry room. The boutique 2-unit building features a low-expense, pay-as-you-go HOA.  Set on the eastern slope of Russian Hill, the home is steps from North Beach, Ghirardelli Square, Polk Street, Jackson Square and Downtown. With its architectural pedigree, panoramic views, private outdoor living, and coveted parking, 750 Francisco is a once-in-a-generation opportunity.
